minute-10.english: At every minute from 1 through 15 and from 31 through 45.
minute-10.translation: Cada minuto de 1 a 15 y de 31 a 45.

minute-11.english: At every 2nd minute from 1 through 30, 40, 41, 42, from 45 through 50, 51 and 52.
minute-11.translation: Cada 2 minutos de 1 a 30, 40, 41, 42, de 45 a 50, 51 y 52.

hour-1.english: At every minute past hour 1 and 2.
hour-1.translation: Cada minuto de la hora 1 y 2.

hour-2.english: At every minute past hour 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5.
hour-2.translation: Cada minuto de la hora 1, 2, 3, 4 y 5.

hour-3.english: At every minute past every hour from 1 through 10.
hour-3.translation: Cada minuto de cada hora de 1 a 10.

hour-4.english: At every minute past every 2nd hour.

hour-5.english: At every minute past every 3rd hour.

hour-6.english: At every minute past every 4th hour.

hour-7.english: At every minute past every 5th hour.

hour-8.english: At every minute past every 2nd hour from 1 through 10.
hour-8.translation: Cada minuto de cada 2 horas de 1 a 10.

hour-9.english: At every minute past every hour from 1 through 5 and from 11 through 15.
hour-9.translation: Cada minuto de cada hora de 1 a 5 y de 11 a 15.

hour-11.english: At every minute past every 2nd hour from 1 through 5, 6, 7, 8, from 10 through 12, 13 and 14.
hour-11.translation: Cada minuto de cada 2 horas de 1 a 5, 6, 7, 8, de 10 a 12, 13 y 14.

day-of-month-1.english: At every minute on day 1 and 2.

day-of-month-2.english: At every minute on day 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5.

day-of-month-3.english: At every minute on every day of the month from 1 through 10.
day-of-month-3.translation: Cada minuto cada día del mes del 1 al 10.

day-of-month-4.english: At every minute on every 2nd day of the month.
day-of-month-4.translation: Cada minuto cada 2 días del mes.

day-of-month-5.english: At every minute on every 3rd day of the month.
day-of-month-5.translation: Cada minuto cada 3 días del mes.

day-of-month-6.english: At every minute on every 4th day of the month.
day-of-month-6.translation: Cada minuto cada 4 días del mes.

day-of-month-7.english: At every minute on every 5th day of the month.
day-of-month-7.translation: Cada minuto cada 5 días del mes.

day-of-month-8.english: At every minute on every 2nd day of the month from 1 through 10.
day-of-month-8.translation: Cada minuto cada 2 días del mes del 1 al 10.

day-of-month-9.english: At every minute on every day of the month from 1 through 5 and from 11 through 15.
day-of-month-9.translation: Cada minuto cada día del mes del 1 al 5 y del 11 al 15.

day-of-month-10.english: At every minute on every 2nd day of the month from 1 through 10, 11, 12, 13, from 15 through 20, 21 and 22.
day-of-month-10.translation: Cada minuto cada 2 días del mes del 1 al 10, 11, 12, 13, del 15 al 20, 21 y 22.

day-of-month-11.english: At every minute on the weekday nearest to the 1st.
day-of-month-11.translation: Cada minuto el día laborable más cercano al 1.

day-of-month-12.english: At every minute on the weekday nearest to the 15th.
day-of-month-12.translation: Cada minuto el día laborable más cercano al 15.

day-of-month-13.english: At every minute on every day of the month from the weekday nearest to the 1st through the weekday nearest to the 5th.
day-of-month-13.translation: Cada minuto cada día del mes del día laborable más cercano al 1 al día laborable más cercano al 5.

day-of-month-14.english: At every minute on the last day of the month.
day-of-month-14.translation: Cada minuto el último día del mes.

day-of-month-15.english: At every minute on every day of the month from 1 through the last day of the month.
day-of-month-15.translation: Cada minuto cada día del mes del 1 al último día.

day-of-month-16.english: At every minute on the last weekday of the month.
day-of-month-16.translation: Cada minuto el último día laborable del mes.

day-of-month-17.english: At every minute on every day of the month from 1 through the last weekday of the month.
day-of-month-17.translation: Cada minuto cada día del mes del 1 al último día laborable.

day-of-week-8.english: At every minute on Monday and Tuesday.
day-of-week-8.translation: Cada minuto el lunes y martes.

day-of-week-9.english: At every minute on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday.
day-of-week-9.translation: Cada minuto el lunes, martes, miércoles, jueves y viernes.

day-of-week-10.english: At every minute on every day of the week from Monday through Tuesday.
day-of-week-10.translation: Cada minuto cada día de la semana del lunes al martes.

day-of-week-11.english: At every minute on every day of the week from Wednesday through Thursday.
day-of-week-11.translation: Cada minuto cada día de la semana del miércoles al jueves.

day-of-week-12.english: At every minute on every day of the week from Friday through Saturday.
day-of-week-12.translation: Cada minuto cada día de la semana del viernes al sábado.

day-of-week-13.english: At every minute on every day of the week from Sunday through Monday.
day-of-week-13.translation: Cada minuto cada día de la semana del domingo al lunes.

day-of-week-14.english: At every minute on every 2nd day of the week from Monday through Tuesday.
day-of-week-14.translation: Cada minuto cada 2 días de la semana del lunes al martes.

day-of-week-15.english: At every minute on every 2nd day of the week from Wednesday through Thursday.
day-of-week-15.translation: Cada minuto cada 2 días de la semana del miércoles al jueves.

day-of-week-16.english: At every minute on every 2nd day of the week from Friday through Saturday.
day-of-week-16.translation: Cada minuto cada 2 días de la semana del viernes al sábado.

day-of-week-17.english: At every minute on every 2nd day of the week from Sunday through Monday.
day-of-week-17.translation: Cada minuto cada 2 días de la semana del domingo al lunes.

day-of-week-18.english: At every minute on every 2nd day of the week.
day-of-week-18.translation: Cada minuto cada 2 días de la semana.

day-of-week-19.english: At every minute on every 3rd day of the week.
day-of-week-19.translation: Cada minuto cada 3 días de la semana.

day-of-week-20.english: At every minute on every 4th day of the week.
day-of-week-20.translation: Cada minuto cada 4 días de la semana.

day-of-week-21.english: At every minute on every 5th day of the week.
day-of-week-21.translation: Cada minuto cada 5 días de la semana.

day-of-week-22.english: At every minute on every day of the week from Sunday through Friday.
day-of-week-22.translation: Cada minuto cada día de la semana del domingo al viernes.

day-of-week-23.english: At every minute on every 2nd day of the week from Sunday through Friday.
day-of-week-23.translation: Cada minuto cada 2 días de la semana del domingo al viernes.

day-of-week-24.english: At every minute on every day of the week from Sunday through Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and from Friday through Saturday.
day-of-week-24.translation: Cada minuto cada día de la semana del domingo al martes, miércoles, jueves y del viernes al sábado.

day-of-week-26.english: At every minute on the last Sunday.

day-of-week-27.english: At every minute on the last Sunday and Thursday.
day-of-week-27.translation: Cada minuto el último domingo y jueves.

day-of-week-28.english: At every minute on Thursday and the last Sunday.
day-of-week-28.translation: Cada minuto el jueves y el último domingo.

day-of-week-29.english: At every minute on the last Sunday and the last Thursday.
day-of-week-29.translation: Cada minuto el último domingo y el último jueves.

day-of-week-30.english: At every minute on every day of the week from the last Sunday through the last Thursday.
day-of-week-30.translation: Cada minuto cada día de la semana del último domingo al último jueves.

day-of-week-31.english: At every minute on every day of the week from the last Sunday through Thursday.
day-of-week-31.translation: Cada minuto cada día de la semana del último domingo al jueves.

day-of-week-32.english: At every minute on 5th Sunday and 3rd Wednesday.
day-of-week-32.translation: Cada minuto el 5.º domingo y el 3.º miércoles.

day-of-week-33.english: At every minute on every day of the week from 3rd Wednesday through 5th Sunday.
day-of-week-33.translation: Cada minuto cada día de la semana del 3.º miércoles al 5.º domingo.

day-of-week-34.english: At every minute on 5th Sunday and Wednesday.
day-of-week-34.translation: Cada minuto el 5.º domingo y miércoles.

day-of-week-35.english: At every minute on every day of the week from 5th Sunday through Wednesday.
day-of-week-35.translation: Cada minuto cada día de la semana del 5.º domingo al miércoles.

day-of-week-36.english: At every minute on every day of the week from Wednesday through 5th Sunday.
day-of-week-36.translation: Cada minuto cada día de la semana del miércoles al 5.º domingo.

month-13.english: At every minute in January and February.
month-13.translation: Cada minuto en enero y en febrero.

month-14.english: At every minute in January, February, March, April and May.
month-14.translation: Cada minuto en enero, en febrero, en marzo, en abril y en mayo.

month-15.english: At every minute in every month from January through November.
month-15.translation: Cada minuto en cada mes de enero a noviembre.

month-16.english: At every minute in every 2nd month.

month-17.english: At every minute in every 3rd month.

month-18.english: At every minute in every 4th month.

month-19.english: At every minute in every 5th month.

month-20.english: At every minute in every 2nd month from January through November.
month-20.translation: Cada minuto cada 2 meses de enero a noviembre.

month-21.english: At every minute in every month from January through February, March, April and from May through June.
month-21.translation: Cada minuto en cada mes de enero a febrero, en marzo, en abril y de mayo a junio.

mixed-2.english: At every minute in Europe/Prague time zone.
mixed-2.translation: Cada minuto en la zona horaria Europe/Prague.

mixed-5.english: At every minute on day 1 and on Monday.
mixed-5.translation: Cada minuto el día 1 y el lunes.

mixed-6.english: At every minute on day 1 and on Monday and Tuesday.
mixed-6.translation: Cada minuto el día 1 y el lunes y martes.

mixed-7.english: At every minute from 0 through 59 past every hour from 0 through 23 on every day of the month from 1 through 31 and on every day of the week from Sunday through Saturday in every month from January through December.
mixed-7.translation: Cada minuto de 0 a 59 de cada hora de 0 a 23 cada día del mes del 1 al 31 y cada día de la semana del domingo al sábado en cada mes de enero a diciembre.
